test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All mangoes are artists.

All kiwis are mangoes.

**Conclusions:**

(I): All kiwis are artists

(II): Some artists are kiwis
solution:
Given Statements:

All mangoes are artists.

All kiwis are mangoes.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48c8c2ad72c2f8ddcc46c250b60834c2a152324af9c33ddc018d6e252bb8306d.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All kiwis are artists - **Follows** (Since all kiwis are mangoes and all mangoes are artists, all kiwis are artists).

II. Some artists are kiwis - Follows (Kiwis are completely inside artists, therefore some artists are kiwis).

So, both conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**
